inputs: Gateway ExecutionObservation-shaped record with exact operationRef/nativeId/ownerId
expected exact operationRef and current task-local proof dependency graph
outputs: OBSERVE_ORIGINAL_OPERATION, RECONCILE_ORIGINAL_OPERATION or VERIFY_DOMAIN_EFFECT_WITH_OWNER readback recommendation
scoped unknown effect reference with existing C04 proof impact projection; malformed inputs produce CircuitContractError
nodes.behavioralContract: Never retries, dispatches, grants permission or certifies an external provider effect. Runtime executionTerminal=true, exitCode=0 and deliveryDisposition=committed still require provider-owned effect confirmation. Missing unindexed effect references broaden UNKNOWN through C04 instead of producing an empty impact.

provider-side effect receipt and durable idempotency/compensation authority
automatic retry, release, deployment, domain acceptance or formal proof admission

Model satisfaction is NOT implementation refinement or observed effect truth: finite concrete input test covers 72 abstract combinations, but arbitrary Python/real Gateway transport, environment, absent dependencies, and provider effects remain UNKNOWN.

nodes.label: TaskLocalCrossDomainBinding
nodes.responsibility: Qualify per-task Web/Security and Research/Artifact cross-domain verification bindings and source-file references while keeping all external providers' semantic authority outside Composition.
nodes.authority: Composition task-local cross-domain binding profile; underlying files/Git retain source truth
inputs: cross-domain R3 JSON binding envelope
repository root and referenced source relative paths
outputs: validated binding or typed contract rejection
repository-contained existing source file reference or typed rejection
nodes.behavioralContract: JSON Schema violations and missing/escaping source paths fail closed. Successful source path resolution means a bounded file exists under the chosen repository root, not that it is source-cut authenticated, installed, executed or a proof of provider semantics.
acceptance: Cross-domain R3 native tests reject malformed binding and parent traversal, and supply scoped Web/Security and Research/Artifact consumer fixtures.
mustNotOwn: file authority outside the selected repository root
formalObligations: A symlink or changed target after Path.resolve()/is_file() must not be presented as immutable SourceCut or safe file-content evidence.
Schema acceptance is distinct from provider authorization or output soundness.
replacements: A mature JSON Schema implementation can replace the current validation adapter if the exact task-local binding behavior is preserved; path confinement remains a separate native file authority obligation.

nodes.label: DelegatedWebSecuritySeamGate
nodes.responsibility: Qualify a task-local Web delegated-Agent security seam from Web/Security dependency contracts, request/admission/store source and bounded browser E2E receipts without promoting result to production Human presence.
nodes.authority: Composition verifier composition; Web/Security owners retain code, identity and effect acceptance authority
inputs: typed cognitive circuit manifest
external binding profile Web/Security binding
source texts and cross-owner dependency contracts
bounded native E2E receipt
outputs: typed composition-gate-result SATISFIED/UNSATISFIED or contract rejection with evidence refs
nodes.behavioralContract: Success requires the declared gate, exact source boundary markers, necessary typed dependency seams and bounded non-production E2E fields. An admissible machine gate cannot assert human physical presence, deployed credential correctness or production eligibility.
acceptance: Cross-domain tests consume the result and inject missing dependency seams, missing source markers and contradictory native E2E fields to obtain rejection/UNSATISFIED.
mustNotOwn: security policy or OAuth/DPoP protocol truth
formalObligations: A true predicate over selected source marker strings is not a formal refinement of real Web authorization behavior.
E2E receipt must be version-qualified against the installed consumer before stronger claims.
replacements: Use a consumer-native Web/Security contract verifier if it can preserve bounded required seams and negative cases.

nodes.label: ResearchArtifactCarrierSeamGate
nodes.responsibility: Qualify a task-local Research publication carrier agreement with Artifact mechanics while preserving scientific, human-perceptual, venue and submission authority outside this gate.
nodes.authority: Composition verifier composition; Research and Artifact own their respective domain verdicts
inputs: typed cognitive circuit manifest
external binding profile Research/Artifact binding
research-publication closure profile
Artifact publication carrier dogfood receipt
outputs: typed composition-gate-result SATISFIED/UNSATISFIED or contract rejection with evidence refs
nodes.behavioralContract: Carrier SATISFIED requires exact profile-owner bindings and a bounded machine-positive dogfood receipt with explicit nonclaims; incomplete Human perceptual signoff and scientific truth can never be upgraded by carrier-mechanical PASS.
acceptance: Cross-domain R3 tests consume Research/Artifact gate evidence and reject falsified profile authority or dogfood contradiction.
formalObligations: Synthetic carrier machine PASS cannot prove domain acceptance, scientific correctness, or a live venue effect.
A change in publication profile, receipt format or exact carrier evidence must invalidate corresponding prior admission.
replacements: Replace this task-local adapter with native Research/Artifact acceptance once it preserves explicit authority separation and negative tests.
